messages.author: c2a4124666613378
messages.subject: Have Vim-R-plugin source shell configuration?
parts:
Hello,

Does anyone know of a way to have vim-r source my .zshrc when spawning a console?

I currently have a custom R_LIBS directory specified there which does not get included, resulting in the vim-r console not being able to find many libraries.

A simple work-around would be to hard-code the path into my .Rprofile, but since the path varies from system to system, I would rather have the shell deal with it.

Any ideas?
Keith

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Have Vim-R-plugin source shell configuration?
parts:
I think this is a Tmux configuration issue, and, perhaps this helps: http://superuser.com/questions/253786/how-can-i-make-tmux-use-my-default-shell

If R is running in an external terminal (if either you are using GVim or Vim isn't already inside Tmux), in addition to editing your ~/.tmux.conf, you will also need to put in your vimrc:

let vimrplugin_notmuxconf = 1

parts:
Hi Jackson,

Thanks for the suggestions. Unfortunately, I tried both changes but still no luck:

In my .tmux.conf, I have:

and in .vimrc:

When I try opening a R console, with either vim inside tmux, or in a terminal, the Console does not pick up any of my shell configuration (e.g. PATH not set properly), however, just opening a tmux session everything is sourced normally (PATH is set as expected.)

Can you think of anything else it might be? Is it possible that it is an issue with ZSH?

Cheers,
Keith
